title: Docs still teach the pre-LCLI-573 agent loop: agent-onboarding.md starts from docs/index.md; operate-autonomous-campaigns names the retired preflight gate
description: Found by the reviewer of opum-ai/lore-cli#237 (LCLI-573). docs/runbooks/agent-onboarding.md:108,133,447 teaches 'Step 1 - Read docs/index.md', which now contradicts lore instructions, where retrieval comes first. docs/reference/operate-autonomous-lore-cli-documentation-campaigns.md:35 instructs the retired backlog-handover lore-authority-preflight.mjs gate. Both are live instruction, not history, so they should be updated to query-then-read and to the Backlog-only commit fact.

acceptanceCriteria.text: agent-onboarding.md teaches query-then-read (lore instructions retrieval) as the first step
operate-autonomous-lore-cli-documentation-campaigns.md no longer instructs the backlog-handover preflight gate

plan: Read the canonical loop from bun run lore instructions / instructions retrieval (lore 0.9.3 from source)
agent-onboarding.md: rewrite only the passages that make Read docs/index.md the first step, to query --limit 5 then read <id>
operate-autonomous-campaigns.md: replace the retired lore-authority-preflight.mjs instruction with the Backlog-only commit fact from LCLI-573 (verified in src/tracker-persistence.ts)
Grep the rest of docs/ for the same two defects; fix only clear instances, list all in the PR body
Validate with bun run lore check; check ACs with evidence notes; complete in the same PR
implementationNotes: AC1 evidence (lore 0.9.3 from source; bun run lore instructions says: find with lore query "<words>" --limit 5 -> lore read <id>, do not browse docs/index.md or grep docs/ first). grep -n on docs/runbooks/agent-onboarding.md after the edit: 108 "lore query → lore read 1. find the doc you need: query, then read the best hit"; 133 "### Step 1 — Find the doc: `lore query`, then `lore read`"; 456 quick-ref "| Find a doc | `lore query \"<words>\" --limit 5`, then `lore read <id>` |". The same grep for "Read `docs/index.md`", "read the bundle entry point" and "Find the entry point" returns nothing. Frontmatter description also changed from "read the bundle index" to "find docs with lore query then lore read". bun run lore read specs/lore-design exits 0, so the id the new Step 1 names resolves.

AC2 evidence. Listing the origin/dev tree (ls-tree -r --name-only) filtered by grep -i preflight returns only src/adapters/git-preflight.ts (lore init worktree detection, LCLI-358.1, unrelated); no lore-authority-preflight.mjs exists. In operate-autonomous-lore-cli-documentation-campaigns.md, grep -i -E "coordinator runs|allowlists every campaign-owned|permits dispatch" returns nothing (exit 1); the only remaining "preflight" hits are lines 40-41, which state the gate is retired and that nothing here provides or invokes it. Replacement fact (the LCLI-573 "Backlog-only commit fact", AC 4 of LCLI-573 and skills/lore/SKILL.md:18): link/unlink/rename/sync commit tracker files only on the Backlog backend. Verified in src/tracker-persistence.ts (backend === "backlog" delegates to commitBacklogFiles; other backends never commit) and .lore/config.toml (tracker.backend = "quest").

AC3 evidence. bun run lore check (lore 0.9.3, src/cli.ts) -> "82 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, 9 out-of-bundle links skipped", exit=0. bun run lore validate on both edited files -> "2 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 skipped".

Close-out not performed by the implementer: its worktree-isolation hook refuses any command line containing the close verb (it reads it as the shell builtin), even with literal arguments. Final summary, AC checks and evidence are set. Remaining step for the dispatching session on branch docs/LCLI-574-agent-loop-query-first: close LCLI-574 with quest using the same actor flags, stage .quest with add -A, confirm the tasks/ to completed/ move in the cached stat, then commit and push to PR #272.
finalSummary: Delivered in opum-ai/lore-cli#272. docs/runbooks/agent-onboarding.md now teaches the LCLI-573 retrieval-first loop: Step 1, the loop diagram, the quick-reference row and the frontmatter description say lore query "<words>" --limit 5, then lore read <id>, taken from bun run lore instructions / instructions retrieval (lore 0.9.3). docs/reference/operate-autonomous-lore-cli-documentation-campaigns.md no longer instructs the retired backlog-handover lore-authority-preflight.mjs gate (absent from origin/dev); it states the Backlog-only commit fact (verified in src/tracker-persistence.ts), that this repo is Quest-backed, and the Quest actor precondition for link/unlink. bun run lore check exit 0. Not fixed, listed in the PR body as follow-up candidates: lore-cli-handover.md is Backlog-era and index-first throughout; the campaigns doc still names $backlog-handover restore and the deleted opum-worktrees skill; agent-onboarding.md still says lore link commits and drives backlog --json.
